description: Tisséo : offre de transport - NeTEx is a dataset listed in Data Toulouse Metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Tisséo Collectivités. En sa qualité d’Autorité Organisatrice de la Mobilité de la grande agglomération toulousaine, Tisséo Collectivités (Syndicat Mixte des Transports en Commun), orchestre l’offre de mobilité, sous la marque Tisséo, sur son ressort territorial: soit 114 communes réparties dans 5 EPCI (Toulouse Métropole, SICOVAL, Muretain Agglo, Grand Ouest Toulousain, Coteaux Bellevue). Coverage: Toulouse Métropole. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are Bus, Métro, Tramway, Tisséo, Transports, Téléphérique. The portal shows 1 records. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-toulouse-metropole-fr-portal.
